newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Corpoven and Exxon plan Orinoco oil project.
newsitem.headline: Corpoven and Exxon plan Orinoco oil project.

text.p: Corpoven, subsidiary of Venezuela's state-owned oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA), and Exxon agreed to do a feasibility study into a crude oil venture in Venezuela's Orinoco Belt, Corpoven said in a statement.
The project aims to produce 160,000 barrels per day (bpd) of extra-heavy crude from east Hamaca in central-eastern Venezuela.
It is one of six projects being considered to exploit the Orinoco deposits, estimated to contain 270 billion barrels in reserves.
"The Exxon technology used in this venture offers significant technical and operational advantages," the statement said.
Corpoven expects to present the project to Congress for approval in the second half of 1997.
